name: Current River — Two Rivers to T. L. Wright Memorial Access
gaugeName: Current River at Van Buren, MO (USGS 07067000)
blurb: The lower Current River from Two Rivers past Van Buren and Big Spring to Doniphan: NPS landings inside Ozark National Scenic Riverways, then Forest Service and MDC accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Two Rivers: approximate NPS access area. Take-out Powder Mill: approximate area only. Ozark National Scenic Riverways: at high river levels the park implements temporary river closures for both commercial and non-commercial vessels. ONSR superintendent's compendium: the compendium sets maximum motor horsepower by river reach. ONSR compendium: the compendium regulates the practice of lashing vessels together and restricts alcoholic beverages in designated areas and periods. NPS paddle pages: "portions are only navigable during certain times due to low river levels." Check river levels and closures before departing. NPS-authorized outfitters (concessioners) rent canoes, kayaks, rafts and tubes and run shuttles inside the park. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: NPS park brochure river miles.

takeOutAccess.directions: The Rocky Creek Conservation Area contains 39,546 acres in the south and east parts of Shannon County. Major tracts can be accessed from Highway 19, Routes H, and E going south off of Highway 106. Additional tracts are located north and south of Highway 106 starting five miles east of Eminence, continuing to the Reynolds County line. Tracts vary in size from over 6,000 acres to 80 acres. Access to areas varies from paved roads to unimproved woods roads, to areas that are only accessible by foot. Detailed ownership maps are available from the Eminence District Office.
